name: House Show 1

date.source: The fed's own newsdesk item, "House Show 1 Results released to general public / Posted Saturday, April 19, 2003" (promotions/tf/archive/house-show-1-2003-04-19.html). 19 April 2003 was a Saturday. The results-posting date is the only date the record gives; the card itself was announced on the fed's own front page, captured the same evening.

notes: The only card TRAUMA:fighting is recorded as having staged. Its front page announced the same four fights, in the same order, before the results were posted.

matches.note: The fed's own results give no winner. What they give instead, whole: "Both men fired" — a consequence rather than a ruling, so the finish is left unresolved.
Billed as the main event. The results read: "Colin Gear beat Rose down badly and came out with the win."
